title: Request enrollment information
content: A parent would like information about enrolling a child in the online Tamil school, including available levels, age groups, schedules, tuition, and the registration process.

title: Request a placement assessment
content: A parent would like the school to assess their child's Tamil level before enrollment or before moving to another class. The request should include the student's age and previous Tamil learning experience.

title: Request a class schedule change
content: A parent would like to move their child to a different class time because of a recurring schedule conflict. The school should check whether a suitable class has space available.

title: Report an absence
content: A parent is notifying the school that their child will miss a class. The request should capture the student's name, class date, reason if the parent chooses to provide one, and whether catch-up materials are needed.

title: Request missed-class materials
content: A parent is requesting worksheets, homework, or other learning materials after their child missed a Tamil class. The school should share materials according to the attendance and make-up policy.

title: Report a technical problem
content: A parent reports that their child cannot join class or cannot access audio, video, class links, or learning materials. The request should include the device type, class time, and any error message.

title: Request a progress update
content: A parent would like an update on their child's Tamil learning, including participation, homework, reading, writing, speaking, and recommended next steps.

title: Ask about homework or classwork
content: A parent needs clarification about a Tamil homework activity, worksheet, due date, or class assignment. The request should identify the student's level and the relevant lesson or material.

title: Request a fee receipt or invoice
content: A parent needs a tuition receipt, invoice, payment confirmation, or correction to billing information. The request should include the student's name and payment date or reference when available.

title: Request withdrawal or refund information
content: A parent is considering withdrawing their child from a class and would like to know the process, effective date, and any applicable refund policy. The request should be sent to the school office for review.

title: Update parent contact details
content: A parent needs to update an email address, phone number, emergency contact, or preferred communication method. The school should verify the parent or guardian before changing student account information.

title: Report a classroom concern
content: A parent wishes to share a concern about their child's online learning experience, classroom conduct, or interactions with others. The school should acknowledge the request promptly and handle it privately through the appropriate staff member.
